text:
Alex H.: Quick cross-team check — we still have gaps in telemetry for billing/metering and per-request latency slices. Need clear owners + blockers before the canary next Tue.
Maria P.: I can own the billing mapping for hosted API, but I need the event schema v2 shape confirmed. cc @Sasha L. @Jasper
Jasper: I can take latency slicing (p50/p95/p99) but I'm blocked on adding a sampling key to the ingest pipeline and the event field names.
Sasha L.: Posted a schema v2 proposal here: <https://go/repo/schema-v2-diff> — delta fields include `sampling_key`, `cost_units`, and `model_variant`. Example payload:
```json
{
  "event": "llm.response",
  "model_variant": "redwood-v1-q4",
  "cost_units": 0.012,
  "tokens_count": 42,
  "sampling_key": "user:123"
}
```
Maria P.: Quick question — is `cost_units` intended per-token or aggregated per-response? We need per-token for accurate attribution.
Samir K.: We should emit both `cost_per_token` and `tokens_count` so downstream can compute attribution. I'll add both to the schema PR.
Alex H.: Owners summary: Maria -> billing mapping; Jasper -> latency slices; Samir -> schema PR. Dependencies: runtime needs to plumb `sampling_key` through headers and the ingest router must accept the new fields. @InfraBot can we schedule a short canary for the telemetry pipeline?
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled for 2027-05-10 02:00 UTC on `telemetry-canary`. Will post status on completion: <https://go/deploy/123>
Sasha L.: Also adding a small example for analytics joins:
```sql
SELECT user_id,
       SUM(cost_per_token * tokens_count) AS total_cost,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95_latency
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE model_variant = 'redwood-v1-q4'
GROUP BY user_id;
```
Jasper: Performance note — emitting per-token fields increases event size. Suggest sampling tokens_count for very long responses (tokens > 512) and adding a `tokens_count_bucket` field for heavy tails.
Maria P.: Agreed. Action items: Samir -> open PR for schema by Friday; runtime team -> header change by Monday; canary Tue. I'll update the tracker and send an owners list.
Alex H.: Thanks everyone. If no objections, I'll mark owners in the project board and loop in security/legal for sampling_key PII review. :thumbsup:
